overall_goal: Clean up the workspace, serve the cooked food and potatoes, and begin washing the dirty cookware

goals.description: Clear the workspace by moving dirty items to the sink
goals.rationale: The person gathers knives, a chopping board, and a plate, and moves them to the sink area to clear the countertop.

goals.description: Clean up the mess from the fallen spatula
goals.rationale: After the spatula falls, the person picks it up, wipes the cupboard and countertop with a kitchen towel, rinses the spatula, and throws the towel away.

goals.description: Retrieve a clean spoon to replace the dirty spatula
goals.rationale: The person opens a drawer, takes out a large plastic spoon, and places it on the countertop for serving.

goals.description: Turn off the heat and serve the main dish onto the plate
goals.rationale: The person turns down and turns off the hobs, then uses the spoon to serve the cooked food from the frying pan onto a plate.

goals.description: Serve and distribute the potatoes onto the plates
goals.rationale: The person scoops potatoes from another frying pan onto the plates and adjusts the portions to ensure they are evenly distributed.

goals.description: Serve the remaining main dish onto the plate
goals.rationale: The person picks up the first frying pan again and scoops the rest of the food onto the plate.

goals.description: Soak and scrape the dirty frying pan
goals.rationale: The person fills the dirty frying pan with water and washing up liquid, heats it on the hob, and scrapes off stuck food with the spoon.

goals.description: Clean up the water spill on the countertop
goals.rationale: The person tears off some kitchen towel, wipes up a water spill caused by the frying pan, and discards the towel in the bin.
